title: Decisions
toc: false
---

Choices that are not obvious get a short architecture decision record (ADR) in `docs/adr/`, in the same pull request as the code. Each record states the context, the decision, its consequences and the alternatives that were rejected.

New records appear here as soon as they are added to that folder. To write one, start from [`0000-template.md`]({{< meta source-repo >}}/blob/main/docs/adr/0000-template.md).
